pkg.lyricsBlock:
[Intro]
(piano instrumental, soft and cold emotional atmosphere)

[Verse 1]
You turned away
like the ending had already been spoken
our words collided again
while the warmth inside us stayed

A sound that never reached the air
lingers quietly in my chest
I’m standing still
inside the echo we left behind

[Pre-Chorus]
Your name remains
in pages never opened
and every truth I carried
loses its way back to me

[Chorus]
Why do we keep missing each other
in every step we take
Apologies and reasons
fall before they reach you

Love makes my eyes sting
in this quiet distance
Please let this voice reach you
because this is love

[Verse 2]
Because it was you
my heart kept trembling
Between longing and resentment
the wind kept turning inside me

I remain like half a sentence
unfinished and fragile
If I erase you now
I fear I might fall apart

[Piano Solo]
(expressive emotional piano solo)

[Bridge]
The final scent of a fading love
drifts through my memory
The more I try to hold it
the softer it becomes

At the far end of that silence
one confession remains
still carrying your name

[Chorus]
Even a single moment
would be enough for me
To see our wounds
as another shape of love

Let us face each other again
with a deeper truth than silence
So our hearts won’t lose their way

[Outro]
(soft emotional piano outro)

Let this echo remain
beyond the ending

And if our voices meet again
let it begin
once more
